name: Skyline Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 5.5 miles / Elevation gain: 1700 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 4.5 hours
why: Signature Paradise loop climbing to Panorama Point through subalpine wildflower meadows below the Nisqually Glacier.

name: Naches Peak Loop Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 3.5 miles / Elevation gain: 500 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 2 hours
why: Easy loop through flowers and huckleberries around Naches Peak from Tipsoo Lake/Chinook Pass, half of it on the Pacific Crest Trail.

name: Burroughs Mountain Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 7 miles to Second Burroughs, 4.7 miles to First Burroughs / Elevation gain: 900 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 2.5 hours
why: From Sunrise past Shadow Lake up onto the tundra plateaus of First and Second Burroughs, facing the Emmons Glacier.

name: Mount Fremont Lookout Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 5.6 miles / Elevation gain: 900 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 3 hours
why: From Sunrise along Sourdough Ridge via Frozen Lake to the 1930s Mount Fremont fire lookout.

name: Comet Falls & Van Trump Park Trail (To Comet Falls)
quote: Distance, round trip: 3.8 miles / Elevation gain: 900 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 3 hours
why: Steady forest climb from the Longmire-Paradise road to the base of Comet Falls.

name: Comet Falls & Van Trump Park Trail (To Van Trump Park)
quote: Distance, round trip: 5.8 miles / Elevation gain: 2000 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 4-5 hours
why: Continues past Comet Falls up switchbacks into the Van Trump Park meadows.

name: Pinnacle Peak Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 2.5 miles / Elevation gain: 1050 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 2 hours
why: Short steep climb from Reflection Lakes into the Tatoosh Range, facing Mount Rainier.

name: Tolmie Peak Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 6.5 miles / Elevation gain: 1010 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 3 hours
why: From Mowich Lake past Eunice Lake to the Tolmie Peak fire lookout.

name: Glacier Basin Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 7 miles / Elevation gain: 1280 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 4 hours
why: From White River Campground up the valley to the meadows of Glacier Basin, with a spur to a view of the Emmons Glacier.

name: Spray Park Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 6 miles / Elevation gain: 1300 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 4 hours
why: From Mowich Lake past Spray Falls up to the flower meadows of Spray Park.

name: Summerland Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 8.4 miles / Elevation gain: 2100 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 4 hours
why: Wonderland Trail section up Fryingpan Creek to the subalpine meadows of Summerland.

name: Rampart Ridge Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 4.6 miles / Elevation gain: 1339 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 2.5 hours
why: Steep forest loop from Longmire to the Rampart Ridge viewpoints, returning on the Wonderland Trail.

name: Bench and Snow Lake Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 2.5 miles / Elevation gain: 700 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 2 hours
why: Gentle ups and downs off Stevens Canyon Road to Bench Lake and Snow Lake.

name: Eagle Peak Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 7.2 miles / Elevation gain: 2955 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 5 hours
why: Steep climb from Longmire through forest to the Eagle Peak saddle in the Tatoosh Range.

name: Shriner Peak Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 8 miles / Elevation gain: 3434 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 5 hours
why: Steep, exposed climb from Highway 123 to the Shriner Peak lookout.

name: Crystal Lakes Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 6 miles / Elevation gain: 2300 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 3 hours
why: Climb from Highway 410 to the Crystal Lakes basin below Crystal Peak.

name: Palisades Lake Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 7 miles / Elevation gain: 1800 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 4-5 hours
why: Trail from Sunrise Point past a series of lakes to Palisades Lake below its cliffs.

name: Owyhigh Lakes Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 7 miles (with return to White River) / Elevation gain: 1350 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 3.5 hours
why: Forest climb from the White River road to the Owyhigh Lakes meadows.

name: Silver Falls Trail
quote: Silver Falls Loop Trail / Distance, round trip: 2.7 miles / Elevation gain: 600 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 1.5 hours
why: Riverside loop from Ohanapecosh Campground to Silver Falls on the Ohanapecosh River.

name: Green Lake Trail
quote: Distance, round trip: 10.8 miles / Elevation gain: 1300 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 4.5 hours
why: Walk up the Carbon River road, then through old-growth forest past Ranger Falls to Green Lake.

name: Lake George & Gobblers Knob Trail (To Lake George)
quote: To Lake George / Distance, round trip: 9.2 miles / Elevation gain: 1,490 feet (approx. 1,100 feet to Round Pass; 390 ft to Lake George from Round Pass) / Hiking time, round trip: 5 hours
why: Up the closed Westside Road to Round Pass and on to Lake George.

name: Lake George & Gobblers Knob Trail (To Gobblers Knob)
quote: To Gobblers Knob / Distance, round trip: 11.2 miles / Elevation gain: 2,585 feet (approx. 1,100 feet to Round Pass; 1,485 ft to Gobblers Knob from Round Pass) / Hiking time, round trip: 6-7 hours
why: Continues past Lake George to the Gobblers Knob fire lookout.

name: Indian Henry's Hunting Ground (Via Kautz Creek)
quote: Via Kautz Creek / Distance, round trip: 11.5 miles / Elevation gain: 3000 feet / Hiking time, round trip: 6-8 hours
why: Long climb from Kautz Creek to the wildflower meadows of Indian Henry's Hunting Ground. The page also lists a 13 mi route via Longmire.

name: Dege Peak via Sourdough Ridge Trail
quote: 3.4 mi/5.5 km roundtrip / 2 hrs
why: Gentle climb from Sunrise along Sourdough Ridge to Dege Peak, with views to Mount Baker and Mount Adams.

name: Carter Falls Trail
quote: 2.2 mi/3.5 km roundtrip / 2 hrs
why: Wonderland Trail section from Cougar Rock Campground to Carter Falls, with Madcap Falls just beyond.
